description: This file defines an Android activity class 'SearchViewAlwaysVisible' that extends a custom 'SearchViewActionBar' class. It overrides a method to always keep the SearchView component expanded, demonstrating persistent search UI in an Android application's action bar.

classes.name: SearchViewAlwaysVisible
classes.description: An Android activity class extending SearchViewActionBar that ensures the SearchView remains expanded and visible at all times.

methods.name: isAlwaysExpanded
methods.description: Overrides the method to always return true, thereby keeping the SearchView permanently expanded.
